documentation.candidate_behavior: Documentation describes the v0.21 integration and iOS port.
documentation.compatibility_impact: No runtime effect; operational claims must match the qualified source.
documentation.test_evidence: P021 evidence files record prior exact-source checks.
documentation.outstanding_validation: Complete P022 release notes and Vietnamese counterpart; preserve explicit physical gate status.

tests.production_behavior: No production behavior; existing v0.19 contracts.
tests.candidate_behavior: Regression, compatibility, security, migration and native-build fixtures.
tests.compatibility_impact: Tests describe intended compatibility but cannot prove device acceptance.
tests.test_evidence: P021 records exact-source Go, frontend, installer, migration and native results.
tests.outstanding_validation: Run the complete P022 matrix on its exact final PR source SHA.

release-native.production_behavior: v0.19 tag workflow builds and publishes iOS assets.
release-native.candidate_behavior: Go 1.27.2 native Agent/Hub build, A7 runtime patch, iOS 12.0 target, checksums, provenance and tag release.
release-native.compatibility_impact: Tag filters must isolate iOS release from branch, PR, dispatch and upstream publication paths.
release-native.upgrade_risk: At P021 baseline, dispatch on a tag could publish; direct live publication occurred before final asset-state verification.
release-native.rollback_risk: A partial or incorrect public release may be resolved as Latest before correction.
release-native.test_evidence: P021 exact-head native job passed and release-ios was skipped; P022 static audit found the dispatch/publish-order gap.
release-native.outstanding_validation: P022 must require push-tag events, verify same-run artifacts/provenance, publish a draft only after validation, and pass exact-head CI.

installer.production_behavior: Rootful installer downloads published Latest and updates Agent/Hub components.
installer.candidate_behavior: Each install/update pins SHA256SUMS and binaries to one strict immutable tag; transactional backup/recovery and ldid pseudo-signing remain in the lifecycle engine.
installer.compatibility_impact: Preserve CLI/binary names, LaunchDaemon labels, installed paths, state roots and component modes.
installer.upgrade_risk: Interrupted extraction or service start can require transactional rollback; Hub schema changes may persist.
installer.rollback_risk: Binary rollback is separate from database rollback; restore a verified cold Hub backup before an older binary after an irreversible migration.
installer.test_evidence: P021 installer CI records bootstrap checksum, lifecycle, transaction and rollback assertions.
installer.outstanding_validation: Validate explicit checksum/provenance-selected staging without changing the Latest default or running a staged candidate on hardware.

go-toolchain.production_behavior: v0.19 source and Go 1.27.1-era release toolchain.
go-toolchain.candidate_behavior: Go 1.27.2 dependencies, isolated Apple A7 runtime patch and official x509 security backport.
go-toolchain.compatibility_impact: Toolchain and crypto changes affect both Agent and Hub binaries.
go-toolchain.upgrade_risk: Open x/crypto module finding and raw x509 scanner traces need current disposition.
go-toolchain.rollback_risk: Rollback may restore old vulnerabilities and does not reverse database schema changes.
go-toolchain.test_evidence: P021 native CI built exact-source binaries and passed CL 851047 x509 tests.
go-toolchain.outstanding_validation: Rerun Go vulnerability scan and exact-source native build/provenance.

version.candidate_behavior: beszel.Version is 0.21.0; iOS tags use v<version>-ios.<positive revision>.
version.compatibility_impact: The pinned snapshot includes commits after the upstream v0.21 baseline; it does not assert a newer upstream stable release.
version.rollback_risk: Older binaries do not undo schema migrations.
version.test_evidence: Source diff and current installer/release validators establish the existing convention.
version.outstanding_validation: Run synthetic tag validation; do not create a tag or release in P022.

database.production_behavior: v0.19 PocketBase collections and ordered migrations.
database.candidate_behavior: v0.20 schema snapshot plus ordered monitor, TLS, ZFS status and socket metadata migrations.
database.compatibility_impact: Users, roles, SSH identities, systems, alert and monitor history, telemetry, records and indexes must survive.
database.upgrade_risk: The removed 1788955200 migration is absorbed into the v0.20 snapshot; interrupted or irreversible schema changes require recovery.
database.rollback_risk: Binary rollback alone is not database rollback; restore a verified cold backup with operator approval.
database.test_evidence: P002 maps the removed migration into the snapshot; P021/P020 record a genuine synthetic v0.19 fixture.
database.outstanding_validation: Rerun exact-head genuine migration, restart idempotence, integrity, backup/restore and injected failures.

frontend.production_behavior: v0.19 Hub UI and frontend/API contract.
frontend.candidate_behavior: Updated dashboard, network-monitor/TLS UI, settings, localization and embedded production assets.
frontend.compatibility_impact: UI fields and API operations must match Hub records, migrations and authorization.
frontend.upgrade_risk: Build dependency exposure and mismatched embedded assets can affect Hub operation.
frontend.rollback_risk: Frontend assets roll back with the Hub binary; database state remains separate.
frontend.test_evidence: P021 records frozen-lockfile Bun build, tests and embedded asset count.
frontend.outstanding_validation: Run Bun, TypeScript, Lingui, Vite, embedded asset and JavaScript advisory checks on exact source.

wifi-deferred.production_behavior: Native iOS Wi-Fi RSSI is not a required supported path.
wifi-deferred.candidate_behavior: Unavailable/disabled native adapter and bounded diagnostic fixtures; no private MobileWiFi linkage.
wifi-deferred.compatibility_impact: Wi-Fi RSSI remains deferred to physical Gate F.
wifi-deferred.upgrade_risk: No automatic native helper execution is introduced.
wifi-deferred.rollback_risk: No schema effect; on-device compatibility remains unverified.
wifi-deferred.test_evidence: P021 native CI checked unavailable adapter and private linkage absence.
wifi-deferred.outstanding_validation: Rerun hosted linkage tests; do not claim physical RSSI or Gate F acceptance.

agent.production_behavior: v0.19 host collectors and Agent/Hub wire contract.
agent.candidate_behavior: iOS CPU, memory, battery, disk and metadata plus updated CPU, network, package, ZFS, SMART, sensor and lifecycle behavior.
agent.compatibility_impact: Preserve legacy payload semantics, CBOR/JSON ordering, SSH/WebSocket lifecycle and platform source selection.
agent.upgrade_risk: Unsupported collectors must fail clearly rather than fabricate values; cross-platform collector changes can affect hosts.
agent.rollback_risk: Agent can roll back independently; Hub records and schema may not be backward compatible.
agent.test_evidence: P021 records Go, telemetry, transport/race, A7 build and iOS source-selection checks.
agent.outstanding_validation: Rerun full Go and affected race suites plus native Agent build; physical A7 launch remains Gate F.

hub-api.production_behavior: v0.19 Hub APIs, auth, PocketBase records and Agent protocol.
hub-api.candidate_behavior: Updated OAuth roles, protected record ownership, monitor history/API and universal-token POST behavior.
hub-api.compatibility_impact: Existing users, roles, owner relationships and Agent protocol must be preserved.
hub-api.upgrade_risk: Authorization regressions can expose or mutate data; migrated defaults must remain least-privilege.
hub-api.rollback_risk: Older Hub binaries may not read new schemas; database restore is separate.
hub-api.test_evidence: P020/P021 record exact-source Go security and migration results.
hub-api.outstanding_validation: Rerun full Go/race/security suites and genuine migration fixture.

deployment.production_behavior: v0.19 Docker, Helm and Debian metadata.
deployment.candidate_behavior: Pinned upstream deployment/package configuration updates; separate from rootful iOS packages.
deployment.compatibility_impact: Image/chart changes affect operators using those channels; iOS suffix tags remain excluded.
deployment.upgrade_risk: Incorrect package/chart metadata can affect service rollout.
deployment.rollback_risk: Package/chart rollback is independent of iOS Hub data recovery.
deployment.test_evidence: Diff inventory and existing workflow tag-isolation tests.
deployment.outstanding_validation: Rerun tag isolation and relevant CI; P022 publishes no packages.

validation-tools.candidate_behavior: Source-selection, A7 runtime patch, Mach-O/provenance validation and diagnostic tooling.
validation-tools.compatibility_impact: Build and safety gates depend on validator correctness.
validation-tools.upgrade_risk: An incorrect validator can accept an unsafe candidate.
validation-tools.rollback_risk: No device state; tool changes must be requalified with the candidate.
validation-tools.test_evidence: P021 native CI exercised the toolchain and artifact validators.
validation-tools.outstanding_validation: Run P022 audit tests and exact-hosted candidate validators.

workflows.production_behavior: v0.19 build and upstream release/package workflow set.
workflows.candidate_behavior: Pinned snapshot native, migration, regression and release/package automation.
workflows.compatibility_impact: iOS suffix tags must remain excluded from GoReleaser and Docker publication.
workflows.upgrade_risk: Event/filter errors can publish packages or assets unexpectedly.
workflows.rollback_risk: Workflow rollback cannot retract a release already published.
workflows.test_evidence: P021 workflow isolation checks cover release.yml and docker-images.yml tag exclusions.
workflows.outstanding_validation: Rerun release isolation on exact P022 source; verify PR, branch and dispatch cannot publish.

configuration.compatibility_impact: Review adjacent protocol, build and data contracts.
configuration.upgrade_risk: Path presence alone does not establish compatibility.
configuration.rollback_risk: Rollback may require a matching binary and database state.
configuration.test_evidence: Full paths are inventoried; P021 records prior regression suites.
configuration.outstanding_validation: Exact-head P022 qualification must cover these changes.
